exact_statement: For every even n>=2, every nonsingular quadratic Boolean phase on n bits, every normalized inherited reference positive on the actual full spectral support, and every adaptive physical query policy with optional actual full-product resets and stopping, using the source-induced kernel with fair zero-source extension, cumulative gross positive reset price C plus current Fourier entropy H is at most n pathwise. Thus the physically weighted sum of erasure KL E and actual outcome KL O, plus full terminal reference KL and entropy, is at most the initial source KL plus n. For the actual selector between dense=sum uj*vj and sparse=(sum uj)*(sum vj), on even n>=4 data bits, start with the ORIGINAL full product, query selector without reset, allow all such dense histories and retain the sparse reference with no resets. The SAME original S=4I bank pays all reached E/O, both full terminal H/K and any old debit omega<=S/4, retaining at least n/2-1>=1. No descendant admission is renewed. Full FEI remains open. In addition, for all nonempty disjoint physical blocks U,V and a new selector y, let F=(-1)^(y parity(U) parity(V)), d=1+|U|+|V|>=3. The ORIGINAL nonproduct reference Q has mass1/2 on vacuum and1/14 on each of the seven other atoms in span({y},U,V), zero elsewhere. For every adaptive physical query policy and stopping cut with actual transported references, fair zero-source extension, and NO resets, the sum of all reached erasure KL E and outcome KL O plus expected FULL terminal H and K is at most c=9/16+(7/16)log2(14)<9/4-1/64. The SAME original4I=d account pays that bill and any old debit omega<=I with residual>3(d-3)/4+1/64. At a selector-first cut the sparse rank-two child inherits (4/19,5/19,5/19,5/19), genuinely different from its uniform actual source, and all its continued physical histories are paid. Original product admission instead fails at the root under allowed old debit I, because every influence is1/4 and M=d h2(1/4)>3I; this is NOT a full FEI disproof. All version1 claims retain their original separate hypotheses.
